description:
Predicted high and low tides (ft above MLLW, NOAA CO-OPS) for the next `days` days at a spot or lat+lon, the hourly tide height curve and inlet current (kt, + flood / - ebb), plus sunrise/sunset and moon phase. Times are ISO with the Eastern offset.
Interpretation: omit boat unless the user supplied or confirmed it. Describe lightning as flashes observed or not detected in the stated window, never a clear/safe guarantee. Report unavailable/QC-failed sources even when freshness.stale=false; fresh does not mean every source is usable. Model sea height is not breaking surf height. Tide heights at different local MLLW gauges do not establish relative channel depths. High tide is not necessarily slack current. For kitesurfing use get_conditions with kiteStyle (freeride/waves/foil), kiteExperience and rider-supplied kiteMinWindKt/kiteMaxWindKt. Read kiteboarding for weather screening, gust spread and explicitly unverified launch status. Never infer the rider wind range, legal launch access or rescue coverage. Activity keys: kite, surf, skim (flatland), skim-wave (wave riding), paddle (flatwater paddleboard), sup-surf (SUP surf). Skim suitability is unscored without shoreline observations; missing scores must not inherit another activity. Offshore wind can favor surf while increasing paddleboard drift risk. A point depth cannot prove route clearance. Do not invent detection percentages, future readings, vessel ownership, or app settings instructions.
Units: ft, kt, s, F, mi; directions FROM. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.

spot.description: Spot id from GET /api/v1/spots, e.g. boca-inlet. Use this or lat+lon.

name: get_tides
title: High/low tides, hourly tide curve, sun and moon
